NagMe Privacy Policy

Effective date: 20 August 2026

Our approach to privacy

NagMe is designed to help you create spoken reminders that keep nagging until you are done. We aim to collect as little personal information as possible and keep your reminder data on your device wherever practical.

Information NagMe may process

Depending on the features you use, NagMe may process:

  • Reminder text you enter into the app.
  • Reminder schedules, repeat settings, snooze settings and nag history.
  • App preferences such as your chosen voice and notification settings.
  • Basic technical information needed for the app to operate on your Android device.

Where your data is stored

NagMe's core reminder data, schedules, history and settings are stored locally on your device. This information is used to provide the reminder and nagging features you request.

AI-powered features

NagMe may include AI-powered features that vary or improve the wording of spoken reminders. When an AI feature is used, the minimum text needed to generate the requested response may be sent securely to the AI service used by NagMe.

NagMe does not intentionally send your full reminder history or unrelated device content to an AI service. We recommend that you do not include passwords, financial account details or other highly sensitive information in reminder text.

Notifications and device permissions

NagMe uses Android notifications, alarms and related device capabilities so reminders can be delivered at the times you choose. Android may ask you to grant permissions needed for these functions. You can manage permissions through your device settings.

Sharing of information

We do not sell your personal information. Information is only shared with service providers when required to provide a feature you choose to use, such as an AI-powered reminder feature, or where disclosure is required by law.

Advertising

NagMe does not currently use third-party advertising networks in the app.

Children's privacy

NagMe is intended as a general productivity and reminder app and is not specifically directed to children. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children through an account registration process.

Deleting your data

Because NagMe's core reminder data is stored locally, you can delete reminders and history within the app. You can also remove locally stored app data using Android settings or by uninstalling NagMe.

Security

We take reasonable steps to protect information processed by NagMe. No system can guarantee absolute security, but we aim to minimise the amount of information transmitted or stored outside your device.

Changes to this policy

We may update this Privacy Policy as NagMe evolves. If the way NagMe handles data changes materially, this page will be updated before or when those changes are released.

Contact

Questions about this Privacy Policy can be sent to support@getnagme.com.
